title: Joyful Souls Ascending
description: A group of joyful blonde children and infant faces float upwards in a swirling vortex toward a bright heavenly light. The children have open-mouthed smiles and reaching arms, surrounded by glowing orbs containing smiling baby faces against a soft pastel sky with clouds.
prompt: A dreamy fantasy scene of multiple laughing blonde children in flowing pastel dresses floating upwards in a spiral toward divine golden light beams breaking through clouds, surrounded by glowing circular orbs each containing a smiling baby face, soft swirling energy patterns, whimsical and joyful atmosphere, rendered in delicate pastel and watercolor style with luminous highlights
